metadata.label: Wandering Tracer Paths
metadata.description: Generates reusable paths that enter from the canvas perimeter and grow across the frame.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Grown tracer paths in centered canvas-height coordinates.

controlDescriptions.count: Sets the number of independent tracer lifetimes, up to four.
controlDescriptions.curl: Sets the stable curvature chosen for each lifetime.
controlDescriptions.pace: Scales artistic time while deposition timestamps remain scene seconds.
controlDescriptions.seed: Chooses perimeter entries, headings, pigments, and hatch families.
controlDescriptions.speed: Sets how quickly each tracer head advances through canvas-height space.
controlDescriptions.sway: Sets a subtle shared-body movement without changing the deposited route.
controlDescriptions.width: Sets the full ribbon width in canvas-height units.
